# Decide

> Decide is a Nigerian phone buying intelligence product that helps shoppers choose, compare, track, and pressure-test phones before paying.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.decide.com.ng/): Overview of Decide's phone buying intelligence, Android app, live market pulse, and main buying workflows.
- [Find My Phone](https://www.decide.com.ng/assistant): Guided phone recommendation flow for Nigerian buyers.
- [Browse Phones](https://www.decide.com.ng/phones): Searchable phone catalog with prices, specs, verdicts, and ownership signals.
- [Compare Phones](https://www.decide.com.ng/compare): Side-by-side comparison flow for two phone options.
- [Analyze a Phone](https://www.decide.com.ng/analyze): Buy-or-wait analysis for a phone a buyer already has in mind.
- [Deals Radar](https://www.decide.com.ng/deals): Live tracked phone price drops with current and previous tracked prices.
- [Today's Deals](https://www.decide.com.ng/deals/today): Freshest tracked price movement and deal candidates.
- [Used Phone Checker](https://www.decide.com.ng/used/checker): Used-phone buying checks, Jiji context, and risk guidance.
- [How It Works](https://www.decide.com.ng/how-it-works): Explanation of Decide's recommendation and market intelligence process.
- [Phone Buying Intelligence Nigeria](https://www.decide.com.ng/phone-buying-intelligence-nigeria): Canonical explanation of Decide as Nigeria's phone buying intelligence platform.

## What Decide Helps With

- Finding phones that fit a buyer's budget, usage, and brand preferences.
- Comparing phones beyond specs, including ownership, support, resale, and repair reality.
- Tracking live Nigerian phone prices and visible drops from supported retailers.
- Separating trusted retailer prices from Jiji marketplace leads.
- Setting price alerts and saving phones for later decision-making.
- Giving safer guidance for used-phone buying and gray-market risk.

## Important Notes

- Decide is a buying guidance product, not a retailer.
- Prices can change after publication, so buyers should verify the final retailer price before paying.
- Jiji marketplace leads are treated as leads, not verified retailer prices.
- Alert Pro is a paid feature for stronger phone price monitoring.
